notes: Pennsylvania resolved 336 of 692 PIAA placer keys (48.6%) and is NO-GO on data, by a source limit rather than a collection miss. The 2025 championship prints no grades at all; 2024 prints 204 of 728 and 2026 prints 325 of 728. Resolution came from tournament prints (211), RankWrestlers dated records (105) and propagation across school-form keys (20), with one adjudicated override. The remaining 356 keys ship with a blank year and do not mint. Verified from the shipped files rather than the package's prose: 2,184 entrant rows, 936 placed, 4,131 bouts, every row stamped PA/PIAA, no duplicate bout IDs (1 Nov 2026).

The failing gate counts two unrelated causes as one number. Of the 110 unaccounted 2026 placers, 31 are PIAA wrestlers with no printed grade, and 79 are PAISWT - the independent-schools championship, whose 520 rows have carried no class year since they were imported on 6 Oct 2026 and have therefore never minted a single profile. Closing the PIAA half needs new evidence that does not exist; closing the PAISWT half is a collection task nobody has been given yet (1 Nov 2026).

PIAA and PAISWT are two separate fields, not two spellings of one. Checked across every PA row: the 2,184 PIAA rows and the 520 PAISWT rows share not one name-and-season pair. Berks Catholic, Bishop McCort and Faith Christian are PIAA members and wrestle PIAA brackets; Malvern Prep, Haverford School, Episcopal Academy, Penn Charter, Wyoming Seminary, Hill School, Germantown Academy and Mercersburg are not. lib/athlete-state.ts now registers PAISWT as PA's independent championship and reads the body from the row's own association column, because every PAISWT row is classified 'Open' and the classification text cannot name it (1 Nov 2026).

Thirty-eight unresolved PIAA champions are named in the package note, among them Jax Forrest, Rune Lawrence, Camden Baum, Dalton Wenner and Aaron Seidel. They are unresolved on class year, not missing from the results: their bouts and placements are in state_tournament_placers; what they lack is a year to mint a profile against (1 Nov 2026).

Fourteen mintable wrestlers appear under more than one school string and were collapsed to one profile each by the mint's name-and-class key. Two of the fourteen are transfers rather than spelling variants and carry the newer school: Caleb Tyler (Delone Catholic 2024-25, Fairfield 2026) and Anna Duncan (Ringgold-G 2024, South Park-G 2025-26). Two school families run three deep, past what the package's two-key groups reported: Eastern Lebanon County-G / Eastern Lebanon Co.-G / ELCO-G, and Notre Dame Green Pond / Notre Dame GP / Notre Dame - GP (1 Nov 2026).

Kylee Trostle's 2024 sixth place was refused by the namesake gate, which saw 'Eastern Lebanon County-G' against the profile just minted under 'ELCO-G' and read them as two wrestlers. One girl, class of 2027. It is the only placed PA row left orphaned from a profile that already exists, out of 2,704 (1 Nov 2026).

The in-season bundle loaded complete: 216 season files, 7,529 matches, onto 160 of the 180 minted profiles. The 20 with no season record are the bundle's own uncovered targets. Two keys the bundle flags as uncovered did in fact land, under the other school form - Morgan Hyland (Easton-G / Easton Area-G) and Aariona Strader (Pine Richland-G / Pine-Richland-G) - so real coverage is 168 of 190 mint keys, not the 166 the package reports (1 Nov 2026).

Bout linkage is 1,351 sides of a possible 8,262, across the 180 profiles, and the shortfall is the profile count rather than the bouts: the importer writes only a side that reaches a profile. The year skew follows from it - 102 sides in 2024, 417 in 2025, 832 in 2026 - because 2024's placers have largely graduated (1 Nov 2026).
